instructions: This file is one part of the interface of Forge Studio, an AI image and video app (Stable Diffusion WebUI Forge).
Translate every value in "texts" (and in "blocks", when there is one) into the language you were asked for. Never change a key: the program finds each text by its English key.
Fill in "language" with the language's own name (for example "Español"), "code" with its short code (for example "es" or "pt-br"), and set "direction" to "rtl" for a language written right to left.

Keep exactly as they are: {0}, {name} and other words in curly braces, %s, ${...}, HTML tags and their attributes, emoji, \n line breaks, numbers and units, keyboard keys, file names and paths, and code.

Keep the names of models, samplers, programs and formats in English (FLUX, SDXL, SD 1.5, LoRA, ControlNet, AnimateDiff, Deforum, Wan, VAE, CFG, Euler a, LCM, Hires. fix, PNG, MP4...). For a technical term the user will meet in English tutorials, add the English in brackets once, for example "Escala CFG (CFG Scale)".
Short labels stay short: they are buttons, tabs and field names. Use the plain, friendly words a video editor or a photo app uses in that language.
A value that should stay in English may stay unchanged.
Return the complete file as valid JSON with the same structure and nothing before or after it.

texts.Instead of generating random prompts fro:
Instead of generating random prompts from a template, combinatorial generation produces every possible prompt from the given string.
The prompt 'I {love|hate} {New York|Chicago} in {June|July|August}' will produce 12 variants in total.

The value of the 'Seed' field is only used for the first image. To change this, look for 'Fixed seed' in the 'Advanced options' section.
texts.Limit the maximum number of prompts gene: Limit the maximum number of prompts generated. 0 (default) will generate all images. Useful to prevent an unexpected combinatorial explosion.
texts.Re-run your combinatorial batch this man: Re-run your combinatorial batch this many times with a different seed each time.
texts.Automatically update your prompt with in: Automatically update your prompt with interesting modifiers. (Runs slowly the first time)
texts.Magic Prompt adds interesting modifiers:
Magic Prompt adds interesting modifiers to your prompt for a little bit of extra spice.
The first time you use it, the MagicPrompt model is downloaded so be patient.
If you're running low on VRAM, you might get a CUDA error.

Uses the lexica.art API to create random prompts.
The prompt in the main prompt box is used as a search string.
Leaving the prompt box blank returns a list of completely randomly chosen prompts.
Try it out, it can be quite fun.
